answer: Give every agent a raven relay licence earned only by completing real deliveries that are written to a shared ocean ledger, so a licence cannot be bought or copied. Each licence needs a 10,000-coin bond locked for 30 days, and a sable audit log re-runs a random 5% of deliveries, burning the whole bond when a delivery is faked. Cloning 200 fake agents then needs 200 licences, 2,000,000 coins bonded, and 10,000 hours of real delivery work, while one caught clone forfeits its entire bond.
